notes.title: Small Patch - Quality Updates
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

This small update addresses a few minor issues and adds a subtle but (hopefully) impactful visual feature to enhance the player's experience!

[b]Change log:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fog and mist effects added to select maps
[*] Removed previous DMG nerf from Crossbows to compensate for their lower hit rates
[*] Added a few missing MP costs to skill item cards from the learning screen
[*] Game font can now only be changed from the title screen, however this change has enabled a fix to a previously reported issue where alternate fonts are too big for certain text boxes
[*] Miscellaneous mapping and eventing fixes
[/list]

I've been very pleased with player reception to Chapter 2 so far and hope to be able to continue developing Chapter 3 (and beyond) with a sense of momentum. Just a reminder, none of the upcoming content will be pushed to the demo moving forward, allowing me to focus on the remainder of the game.

Thanks to everyone who has downloaded the demo, left a review or comment, or even just read these little updates from time to time - your support means a ton!

Happy questing!

--Chris
(developer, Runelight Owl)

notes.title: Moonfell: the Tides of Aether - Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

The demo for [i]Moonfell: the Tides of Aether[/i], covering the prologue and chapter 1, has been updated with some new features, balance changes (especially to Expert Mode), and general improvements.

This release includes:

[list]
[*] Evaluate target status conditions by hovering the cursor over them (works with mouse and controller now!)
[*] In-battle Status menu available from the party command input window
[*] Enhanced cutscenes and some re-written dialog
[*] Fixed a bug where the party member faces wouldn't always show up on the Save screen
[*] The Options menu now displays F-key shortcuts for functions such as displaying FPS or changing screen size
[*] A few compass and minimap tweaks
[*] One of the bandits on the Fort exterior has a new interaction with Lunara's Arrow skill
[*] Improved item and skill list sorting
[*] Some general map fixes
[*] Expert Mode stat changes have been slightly reduced
[*] Regular enemies in Expert Mode now have a chance to spawn as a special Variant with additional abilities!
[*] Save Crystals in Expert Mode always respawn enemies for extra challenge
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who has played the demo! Your feedback, ratings, comments, and support are tremendously appreciated!

--Chris (Developer, Runelight Owl)
